name: gitstack
description: Safe local Git and connector-first GitHub workflows for commits, issues, reviews, CI, releases, and pull-request delivery.

interface.longDescription: GitStack combines careful local Git authoring with connector-first GitHub issues, pull requests, review feedback, Actions diagnostics, releases, stars, portfolio triage, and draft-PR publication. It uses direct git for local state, the GitHub connector for supported remote work, and gh for connector gaps.
defaultPrompt: Triage this repository's open issues and pull requests.
Diagnose and fix the failing GitHub Actions checks.
Publish these local changes as a safe draft pull request.
